units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:9:1">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵈ</cite> top <he>ויָדוֹךְ וכ׳</he> but why should he not pound a day before?—Part. pass. <cite ref="D00754"><he>דָּךְ</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="D00755"><he>דַּךְ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to designate, mark off, v. דּוּךְ II. [Gen. R. s. 5, v. דּוּךְ III.]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:7">Bets. I, 7</cite> <he>נִדּוֹכִין כדרכן</he> are pounded (on Holy Days) in their usual way.
<cite ref="Beitzah 14a:8">Ib. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>לָדוֹכָהּ וכ׳</he> as to pounding it (salt) alone.
<cite ref="Yoma 75a:18">Yoma 75ᵃ</cite> <he>דבר שנ׳ וכ׳</he> something which is pounded in the mortar (spices); a. fr.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 848:1">Yalk. Ps. 848</cite> <he>מְדוּכָּכִים אנו</he> we are crushed (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>מדוכנין</he>, v. <cite ref="D00783"><he>דָּכַן</he></cite>).
